timeout: The tracker data has not loaded yet. Check your connection and keep this page open; it updates by itself.
dbUnavailable: The tracker database is not available in this view. Open this page on claude.ai or in the Claude desktop app while signed in.
revoked: Access to the tracker data ended for this view.
writeFailed: Could not save the change. Only the tracker owner can change settings.
emptyTree: The skill tree is empty. Run /gcp-cert-coach:init in a chat to build it from the official learning path.
planPaused: The plan is paused; any learning command resumes it.
planDone: All required activities are complete. Keep practicing until every module is ready.
qEmpty: Nothing queued. Mark a module completed or answer quiz questions.
calibEmpty: Answer a few questions with confidence ratings to see your calibration.
staleSync: The learning path and exam guide were last checked {days} days ago. Ask Claude to sync the tracker.
schemaNewer: This tracker uses a newer data version than this page. Ask Claude to rebuild the tracker page.
levelHelp: Module level: average of all exam-relevant concepts, including untested ones (they count as 0). Coverage: share of concepts answered at least once.
conceptHelp: Concept line: level · correct/answers (for example 25 · 1/1 = level 25, 1 correct of 1 answer).
howLevels: Each concept has a level from 0 to 100. A correct answer raises it, more for harder questions and higher confidence; a correct guess adds nothing; a confident mistake lowers it most. Levels fade when a concept is overdue for review. A module is ready when its level, coverage, answers, distinct days and recent results meet your difficulty profile. Concepts mastered counts concepts at or above the ready level.
pageOutdated: This page is older than your plugin ({page} → {latest}). Say 'rebuild' in chat to update it.
